chinese: 是以圣人后其身而身先；
pinyin: Tiān dì suǒ yǐ néng zhǎng qiě jiǔ zhě，
Yǐ qí bù zì shēng， gù néng zhǎng shēng。
Shì yǐ shèng rén hòu qí shēn ér shēn xiān；
Wài qí shēn ér shēn cún。
Fēi yǐ qí wú sī xié，
english:
The Tao of Heaven is eternal,
and the earth is long enduring.
Why are they long enduring?
They do not live for themselves;
thus they are present for all beings.
